worked_solution:
First, we express our triple integral as a repeated integral:

$$
{∭}_{R}2x+3{y}^{2}+4{z}^{3}\,\text{d}V={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{3}2x+3{y}^{2}+4{z}^{3}\,dx\,dy\,dz
$$

Since we're integrating first with respect to $x,$ then $y,$ and then $z,$ we write $\text{d}V=\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z.$

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $x,$ treating $y$ and $z$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{3}2x+3{y}^{2}+4{z}^{3}\,dx\,dy\,dz & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{3}2x+3{y}^{2}+4{z}^{3}\,dx]dy\,dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}[{x}^{2}+(3{y}^{2}+4{z}^{3})x]_{x=0}^{x=3}\,dy\,dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}(9-0)+(3{y}^{2}+4{z}^{3})(3-0)\,dy\,dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}9+9{y}^{2}+12{z}^{3}\,dy\,dz\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $y,$ treating $z$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}9+9{y}^{2}+12{z}^{3}\,dy\,dz & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{2}9+12{z}^{3}+9{y}^{2}\,dy]dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[(9+12{z}^{3})y+3{y}^{3}]_{y=0}^{y=2}\,dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(9+12{z}^{3})(2-0)+3(8-0)\,dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}18+24{z}^{3}+24\,dz \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}42+24{z}^{3}\,dz\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $z:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}42+24{z}^{3}\,dz & =[42z+6{z}^{4}]_{z=0}^{z=1} \\  & =42(1-0)+6(1-0) \\  & =48\end{aligned}
$$
